hypothesis: W-R14's perfect order recognition may rely on positives with exactly equal anchor-relative sequences. Add bounded per-tick observational jitter that keeps positive order intact, and test whether the same capacity-matched representations distinguish from order-changing negatives under stronger unseen jitter.
freeze: All data generation rules, distortion amplitudes, labels, feature maps, training algorithm and thresholds are preregistered before first scientific execution; never adapt to heldout outcomes.
source: Exactly the original 16-tick 4-channel synthetic generator frozen in W-R11/W-R12, with observed candidate's all-channel global offset and per-tick signed integer jitter.
development_nuisance: Apply +17 modulo256 to all channels of candidate; then per-tick jitter=((3*t+entity+seed)%3)-1 to all four channel values. Positives retain resulting candidate temporal order; negatives reverse its 15-tick tail for even entities and rotate left three for odd entities.
heldout_nuisance: Apply +61 modulo256, then per-tick jitter=((3*t+entity+seed)%5)-2, and a heldout-only even-index-then-odd-index tail weave for negatives.
arms: unordered 16-bin relative-to-anchor first-channel modulo16 histogram difference
16 copies of unscaled mean circular anchor-relative positional mismatch
16 copies of mean mismatch calibrated by minimum negative mean seen only in development; both trained models same budget
learning: 16 weights + one bias, zero init, 32 fixed epochs, learning rate 0.1, 72 examples per candidate, no heldout calibration.
primary: Report full heldout confusion matrix per seed and balanced accuracy. ROBUST_TEMPORAL_TRANSFER if at least one pooled arm>=0.85 and unordered control<=0.55; PARTIAL if max pooled>unordered but misses .85; NEGATIVE otherwise. Preserve failures and control confounds.
validation: Exact parent/source Git blob identity, equal-width/updates budget, positive/negative candidate first-row and multiset equality within seed+entity, correct labels, train-only calibration and deterministic output, one full repo regression.
claim_limit: Supervised toy temporal perturbation discrimination; no real language learning, reasoning, or accepted-ref mutation.
